title: Quarterly roadmap readout and board Q&A prep with risk register
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Prepare Redwood's quarterly roadmap readout materials for the executive leadership and board Q&A. Deliverables include a concise executive deck (10-12 slides), a one-page strategy summary for board members, a prioritized risk register with mitigation plans, a decision log capturing open trade-offs, and speaker notes / Q&A playbook. Coordinate cross-functional reviews (Eng, Design, Security, Sales) and organize a dry-run for ELT. Ensure the deck highlights OKR progress, key bets for the next quarter, material risks, and go/no-go decisions for major initiatives.
background: Leadership requested a tighter readout format this quarter focused on economic trade-offs and runway impact. Recent Dedicated capacity incidents surfaced gaps in target SLO communications. We need to ensure the board has clarity on cost/latency trade-offs and the contingency plans for Dedicated and Private deployments. This ticket consolidates PM-owner responsibilities for preparing artifacts and aligning stakeholders ahead of the QBR slot.
objectives: Produce a 10-12 slide executive deck tailored for board-level discussion
Create a one-page strategy summary for quick reference
Publish a risk register with owner, impact, likelihood, and mitigation
Capture a decision log for any suggested pivots or go/no-go signals
Facilitate at least two cross-functional reviews and one ELT dry-run
success_metrics: Deck accepted by CEO and Head of Product without major revisions
Risk register items have assigned owners and mitigation timelines
At least 80% of rehearsal Q&A scenarios have scripted answers
Board feedback results in no more than two action items requiring engineering rework before next release
deliverables: Risk register (spreadsheet) with owners and timelines
